description:
RFC 5280 §6.1.2 requires that the initial NameConstraints state (permitted_subtrees, excluded_subtrees) be seeded from the trust anchor when the anchor has a NameConstraints extension. Currently chain_walk always starts with nc_permitted=None and nc_excluded=empty, silently ignoring any NameConstraints extension on the trust anchor certificate. A trust anchor configured with permittedSubtrees or excludedSubtrees will have those constraints completely ignored, allowing certificates that should be rejected to pass validation.

Deliverables:
1. TrustAnchor gains an optional name_constraints field (Option<NameConstraints>)
2. TrustAnchor::from_cert populates it automatically
3. chain_walk seeds nc_permitted/nc_excluded from the matched trust anchor before walking the chain
4. PKITS §4.13.18-19 tests are unblocked IF the self-issued exemption (PKIX-8wp) also lands; otherwise a targeted unit test covers the trust anchor seeding directly
5. Supersedes PKIX-27p.1

title: TrustAnchor NC: seed chain_walk from trust anchor NameConstraints extension
